summary: Learning check: none of L1-L5 names the fundamentals analyst in applies_to and I have no graded calls yet, so nothing shaped the ranking; I only used the L3 label caveats (DPZ, MSCI) as context. The best combination of profitability, cash backing and a clean nine-test score is VRSN (F9, gp 1.10 at the 99th sector percentile, cfo 1.09B vs net income 0.83B), then MSM (F9) and CARG (cfo about 1.9x net income). The menu is as of 2026-11-03 and prices predate the 11-05 selloff, so rankings rest on fiscal-year fundamentals only. Main concerns are cash conversion below earnings (DORM, GRMN, MLI), amended filings (GRMN, ONC), and stale fiscal years (CLX, SMG, TTEK, BLBD, SBH).
